summary.headline: Omens in the Subsequent Triplicities
summary.text: Astrological omens of planetary configurations in the subsequent triplicities, especially when the configuration falls in Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, or the watery triplicity. The text forecasts diseases, winds, rain, political conflict, deaths, war, travel dangers, and the fortunes of rulers, judges, scholars, merchants, and commoners.
